subject: prd/implementation-verification
statement: If the invocation is invalid — unknown mode, missing or ambiguous diff base or workspace, or a flag-like positional argument, then the system shall refuse with a usage error before any rung executes, emitting only a configuration-error verdict
intent: configuration-error verdict naming the invocation defect
fit_criterion: the malformed-invocation fixtures (each defect class, including a flag-like positional) yield refusal with zero verbs executed — the incident-I3 discipline
